title: exec-staff-meeting-prep-notes-2026-03-14
content:
Goal: Quick sync on top risks, runway metrics, Dedicated/DC launch readiness, and approval for 2 q2 hires. Keep to 45m (update-only) + 15m decisions.

Agenda (60m)
- 0-5m: Quick wins / shoutouts (Avery)
- 5-15m: Key metrics highlight (Samir) — runway, cash, committed Dedicated customers, M/M revenue growth, Hosted API traffic anomalies
- 15-30m: Dedicated & Private launch status (Lena) — data plane readiness, KMS work, SOW for customer X
- 30-40m: Reliability incidents & SRE ask (Ethan) — SLOs, recent latency regression, mitigation plan
- 40-50m: Sales/Customer success flag — 2 enterprise opportunities needing exec support
- 50-60m: Decisions & approvals — hires, budget reallocation, priority on model onboarding
- 60-75m: Open issues / parking lot / quick Qs

Prep notes / talking points
- Metrics (Samir)
  - Cash runway: ~14 months at current burn (pre-Dedicated revenue). Need to model conservative case (no Dedicated conversion) — action: finance to run scenario by Mon 3/16.
  - M/M revenue: +8% (hosting), Dedicated pipeline growing but conversions slow — pipeline: 6 P0 accounts (>$50k ARR each), 2 in legal/contract stage.
  - API latency p50/p95: p50 steady ~80ms, p95 jumped 30% last week after kernel update on the fleet (INF-3421). We think a subset of nodes rolled with new kernel + cuDNN mismatch.

- Dedicated & Private (Lena)
  - Data plane: autoscaling tests passed in staging but edge-case with cold starts for KV-cache observed (adds ~250ms). Need production mitigation (pre-warming or graceful degraded path).
  - KMS/HSM: Integration with AWS KMS in place; HSM vendor contract still pending redline. Legal reviewing — target sign by 3/21.
  - Onboarding docs: missing step for network egress rules in private deployments causing friction with early adopter (Customer X). Draft SOW updated; want exec sign-off on revenue recognition approach for Dedicated pilots.

- SRE / Reliability (Ethan)
  - Incident summary: two latency regressions last week (one infra, one model-serving). Root cause for infra regression is rolling kernel; mitigation: rollback on affected ASGs — done. Model-serving regression tied to a new attention kernel in runtime (PR #987) — reverting until perf tests complete.
  - Ask: temporarily raise maintenance window SLA with top customers to allow safe rollback and kernel rollforward testing. Need Exec sign-off to notify top 5 customers.

Risks / flags to surface
- Sales dependency: Closing 2 enterprise deals expected in Q2 to fund Dedicated capacity — if delayed, cash runway stress. Need alignment with sales on discounting policy for large pilots.
- Compliance: Private on-prem checklist not yet complete for EU data residency for Customer Y — risk to timeline.
- Hiring: need 2 infra engineers (serving-runtime) with ML infra experience and 1 sales engineer for Dedicated pre-sales. Role approvals needed this week to get in interview loop.

Decisions requested (for 50-60m slot)
1) Approve 2 new infra hires (serving-runtime) + 1 sales engineer — total AC ~ $540k annual run rate. (Owner: Avery)
2) Approve customer notification for elevated maintenance window for 2 weeks to allow rollback/testing. (Owner: Ethan)
3) Approve revised SOW revenue recognition approach for Dedicated pilots for Customer X (Owner: Lena)

Action items (follow-ups)
- Samir: produce conservative cash model (no Dedicated conversions) and best-case model by Mon 2026-03-16. -> Samir Gupta -> due: 2026-03-16
- Lena: finalize KMS/HSM redline & target legal sign-off; share SOW revenue note for exec review by Fri 3/20. -> Lena Morales -> due: 2026-03-20
- Ethan: draft customer notification template for maintenance window and list of top-5 customers to notify; coordinate with CS. -> Ethan Brooks -> due: 2026-03-15
- Hiring (Avery): submit reqs to People Ops and get approval for 3 roles; share shortlist timeline. -> Avery Chen -> due: 2026-03-18
- Infrastructure (infra-eng lead): run production KV-cache pre-warm experiment and report perf delta. -> (linked) JIRA:INF-3450 -> due: 2026-03-17

Parking lot / questions to resolve offline
- Discount policy for pilot contracts over $100k — need guardrails (finance + sales).
- EU on-prem compliance checklist: who owns sign-off? (Security + Legal)
- Should we fast-track model onboarding for top 3 enterprise customers (manual instrumentation + SLOs) — tradeoff: divert infra eng to onboarding vs core runtime improvements.

Notes to self / informal
- Keep meeting tight. Prioritize decisions 1-3. If time limited, table metrics deep-dive.
- Pull recent Grafana panels for p95 latency, kernel rollout history, and Dedicated pipeline slide (sales) — attach to meeting invite.
- Remind CS to surface any escalations from Customer X before meeting.

Quick links
- Exec roadmap: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/EXEC/pages/Executive-Roadmap-2026
- INF-3421 (latency regression): https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3421
- PR #987 (attention kernel): https://github.com/redwood/serving-runtime/pull/987
summary: Prep for exec staff sync 3/14: metrics, Dedicated launch readiness, SRE asks, and 3 exec decisions (hires, maintenance window, SOW). Action items assigned (Samir, Lena, Ethan, Avery).
